subject: AstraCloud marketplace connector — prerequisites and contract asks
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amira Habib <amira.habib@astracloud.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: AstraCloud marketplace connector — prerequisites and contract asks

Amira / team — thanks again for the demo last week. Quick summary and asks from our side as we kick the marketplace listing + embedded SDK conversation forward.

TL;DR
- AstraCloud wants a marketplace listing and an "embedded SDK" option for customers that want the connector bundled in their org.
- They require a short SOW + listing agreement that defines entitlements and billing flow for usage-based invoicing.
- Need clarification on security questionnaire items before we ship an on-prem package.

Can the internal group weigh in on feasibility and timelines (ideal: listing + SDK alpha by end of Q1 2027):

Product / Technical asks:
- Confirm whether we can support a packaged connector that runs in the customer VPC with the same token/entitlement checks as hosted flows.
- Connector should honor per-customer entitlements (marketplace marketplace entitlement ID) and return meterable usage to our billing pipeline.
- Document-level KV cache behavior needs to be defined (customer wants cache locality to avoid cross-tenant leakage). See attached connector_spec.yaml for initial draft.

Commercial / Legal asks (from AstraCloud):
- AstraCloud requests a two-tier listing: "Marketplace listing" (public) + "Embedded SDK" (private distribution to ISVs that purchase the bundle). They want explicit language in the SOW on distribution and resale rights.
- They provided an initial SOW template (attached) and their security questionnaire (attached).

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik: quick feasibility note + estimated delta to runtime and billing (2-3 bullets).
2) Vanessa: confirm commercial model we can support (resale + entitlement flow) and preferred pricing primitives (monthly committed seats vs usage).
3) Laura: can you flag legal must-haves for the SOW + any dealbreakers in the security questionnaire?
4) Amira: can AstraCloud accept a 30-day SOC / audit window for the alpha?

Attachments: AstraCloud_SOW_v1.pdf, connector_spec.yaml, security_questionnaire_20261101.pdf

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez

On Mon, 02 Nov 2026 at 14:12, Mateo Alvarez wrote:
> Amira / team — thanks again for the demo last week...

Quick technical readout from infra/runtime:
- Feasibility: yes — we can support an embedded connector that runs in-customer (VPC) and authenticates back to our entitlement service. The work splits into three main areas: auth/entitlement plumbing, packaging/ops for the on-prem bundle, and billing telemetry.

Major implementation notes / risks:
- Entitlement checks: we need a small, signed client binary (or container) that validates entitlement tokens against our control plane. This requires a short-lived key exchange; we will need AstraCloud to accept a lightweight outbound TLS call to redwood-inference.com.
- Billing telemetry: current hosted metrics pipeline expects per-request routing; for on-prem we need a usage reporting shim that batches meter events and pushes to our ingestion endpoint. This adds ~2 weeks of infra work to the connector timeline (end-to-end).
- KV cache: we can provide strong tenant isolation if the connector uses a local cache keyed by customer_id; this is straightforward but must be called out in the SOW to avoid expectations mismatch.

Estimated delta to roadmap (alpha -> GA):
- Alpha (internal + AstraCloud pilot): 8 weeks (packaging + entitlement shim + telemetry).
- GA: additional 6 weeks for stability, billing reconciliation, and marketplace listing automation.

Blocking questions for Astra/Legal:
- Can we rely on a single outbound TLS endpoint for entitlement/telemetry? (we will fail closed if unreachable)
- Any required offline/auditable logs that the customer expects us to retain? We currently expose token-level audit logs for hosted customers under DR policy only.

I can flesh this into a short tech note if that helps for the SOW.

— Karthik
Head of Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Amira Habib <amira.habib@astracloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: AstraCloud marketplace connector — prerequisites and contract asks

Thanks Mateo — and hi Amira. A few commercial thoughts from Partnerships/GTMPM: 

1) Listing + Embedded bundle model:
- We can do a two-tier approach: public listing (pay-per-usage via marketplace) and a private "embedded SDK" bundle sold through AstraCloud to their ISVs. The embedded bundle will be treated as "resale" and require a reseller addendum in the SOW.

2) Pricing primitives:
- Preferred: usage-based billing for the public listing (per-token or per-embedding unit depending on the feature set) + a negotiated margin for the embedded bundle (we typically accept a 10-20% channel margin).
- For pilots, suggest a 3-month free pilot or a $0-5k committed minimum to validate metering.

3) Marketplace entitlements and Fulfillment:
- We need AstraCloud to provision an entitlement_id per ISV customer and map that to our entitlement service. We will provide a small onboarding script and an entitlement mapping CSV template.
- Integration with marketplace billing requires a DocuSign + listing agreement; Laura, can you draft a short reseller addendum?

4) Timelines:
- If tech delta is ~8 weeks to alpha, then commercial + legal sign-off timeline should be prioritized in parallel — target to have SOW + reseller addendum signed in 4 weeks. DocuSign link attached above will be used once legal approves terms.

Amira — can your team confirm whether AstraCloud's ISVs expect white-label distribution, or if the bundle will carry Redwood branding? That will affect the reseller language.

Thanks — Vanessa
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: AstraCloud marketplace connector — prerequisites and contract asks

Vanessa / team — quick legal flags after skimming the SOW and questionnaire. High level: we can proceed but need these items addressed before we sign any reseller agreement.

Key redlines / must-haves:
- Liability and indemnity: propose a mutual cap at the greater of €1,000,000 or 3x fees in the prior 12 months. AstraCloud's template currently lists unlimited liability for certain data events — need to cap.
- Data residency & access: if AstraCloud requires logs/audit copies to be stored on-prem, we need to define retention windows and a request/approved process. We should not agree to continuous full-access to our telemetry.
- Audit rights: limit to scheduled audits (30 days notice) and scoping language only for security controls relevant to the connector. No open-ended audit rights.
- Distribution/resale: reseller addendum should include a clause that prohibits AstraCloud from sublicensing the connector to any third party without written consent for restricted verticals (finance/healthcare) unless we agree to SOC-evidence levels.

Operational asks for the SOW: include Karthik's technical bullet on outbound TLS + fallbacks and Vanessa's entitlement mapping CSV as exhibits. We'll attach a short set of acceptable security evidence (SOC2 + pen test summary) in lieu of continuous log access.

I can produce a redline by EOD tomorrow. If AstraCloud accepts our draft redlines, we can route to their contracts mailbox (contracts@astracloud.com) and start the DocuSign flow.

— Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
